title: Origins: Jovian
description: Origin datapack that adds the Jovian, an origin based on the Happy Ghast.
body:
Origin datapack that adds the Jovian, an origin based on the Happy Ghast.

Derived of the Happy Ghasts, these creatures freely move around the skies and are able to heal others through their moistening abilities.

![Jovian Power List](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/098bcc739e8a815161763f931f1e57fa640e8151.png)
